entry_points.text: Reader binds, lowers priority, signals start, then loops masked read-side pairs with shutdown wait. Expedited binds, raises priority, honors an initial pause, then loops delay plus expedited wait with shutdown wait.

Teardown checks the expedited mix, stops groups, summarizes completions and timing, checks reserve balance, frees tables and runs flavor teardown. Kfree teardown stops its groups, frees tables and closes the session.

Kfree thread binds, samples memory, allocates batches freed via deferred paths, tracks grace counts at peer sync, reports time and footprint, may power off. Its handler recovers the object from the record and frees it.
Init validates lazy timing: stretches the interval, drains, probes one callback, checks the elapsed window, restores, starts workers awaiting startup, unwinding failures centrally.

exports.text: Classic and rude Tasks printers select the respective instance and delegate to the shared generic printer with an empty qualifier.
Global thread shower dumps overall state racily, highlights nodes with outstanding work skipping idle, totals invoked callbacks, adds offload and Tasks summaries.
Tree enqueue forwards to a common helper with lazy allowance; tiny links at the global tail under masked interrupts and nudges scheduling from idle. Both leak repeats with bounded diagnostics.

Polling snapshot returns normal plus expedited counters with a barrier using global normal; watching query tests the caller without tracing; force funnels leaf to root with try locks, records once, wakes the thread.
Tree barrier serializes on a mutex with early exit, snapshots, covers each processor, waits on a biased completion, closes and publishes. Tiny barrier uses one expedited wait.
Lazy-flush accessors read and update the aging limit for lazy-only bypass, used by flush and deferred wake timing. Async helper hurries when lazy is off or a hurry section is active.

hazards.text: Without offload, guards are no-ops, flush claims success, wake claims none, and enqueue helpers are dead code with a warning. Further once-warnings mark bypass contention, boot or post-flush residue, and barrier mismatch as logic faults.

Tables and descriptors are assumed present with sparse warnings. Diagnostics are racy and may tear, unfit for control. Enqueue risks misalignment, null handlers, repeats, offline and early use. Scale risks allocation abort and ordered shutdown clearing.

invariants.text: Shared Tasks printer reports grace identity, queue tuning, per-processor pending, barrier timing and holdouts via a temp set. Thread shower aggregates callback, urgency and lazy-timer presence then logs identity and progress; shims forward the selected type.
State naming maps numbers via a table with placeholder fallback out of range, mixing racy and stable reads to expose races without repeated loads.

Classic and rude read helpers are vacuous with constant success; tracing helpers bracket a real region. Seq distance prefers the descriptor rule else arithmetic. Flavor macros emit a reference plus separator or nothing.
Shutdown waiter hints quiescence, returns while writers run, else sleeps uninterruptibly for stop. Count normalization keeps nonnegatives else derives from online count plus offset clamped to one.

Allocator serves a private list, refilling in bulk from the shared reserve, warning rate-limited if the top table is absent. Release tolerates absent blocks; async completion decrements outstanding first.

Offload shower opens with the leader view, exits if not offloaded, else reports queue, bypass, thread, lock, sleep and wait state with segment markers. Leader adds seqs, range, loops and placement. Empty variants cover feature-off builds.
Scale and barrier tracing emit lockless summaries: module parameters, barrier phase with target count seq, grace-request name node values level range tag.

Common enqueue validates alignment and handler once, inits the list during early disabled startup, checks overload, dispatches offloaded or local under interrupt cover. Active grace comes from state bits; wrap tracks lag; new periods clear ticks and snapshot softirq time.

Unlocked accelerate skips the node lock when a prior request is live, else locks and wakes if asked. Accelerate refreshes, reassigns, may start a grace and traces pre and post. Strict builds pair a section on noting. Nocb identity and offload-read safety need designated guards or nocb context.

Overload mask tracks per-group length against a threshold with a lockless fast path. Online tests group bits via one atomic read. Main length counts bypass before insertion; flush moves all plus a newcomer and resets lazy state. Flush need is pure in size, lazy size, age and time.

Wake needs a valid target; yielding threads wake only from idle. Advance without wake needs list cover, active grace and try-lock success. Direct enqueue appends with traces assuming caller cover. Lazy probe uses a dedicated object, stamp and flag set once.

locks.text: One config needs interrupts disabled plus the nocb lock when offloaded for list access; the other needs only disabled interrupts. Core wakeup masks interrupts while flagging work and waking a present non-current thread.
Offload uses an outer guard only when enabled with interrupts disabled, plus a separate bypass guard with fast attempt. Flush requires the outer guard then takes bypass internally.

Node updates run under the node guard; opportunistic advance uses try-lock only. Entrainment needs the barrier guard. Group sleep, defer level and timer run under the leader guard with cancel expecting it held.

state_machines.text: Writer sets affinity and scheduling with pauses, gates on boot unless expedited, barriers at start, loops async versus expedited versus normal waits with barrier fallback, captures durations with stall checks, barriers at end and publishes counts.

Initiation walks to the root, bailing if already needed or covered, else publishes need with init flag and stamp and reports whether to wake. Wakeup skips from the same thread outside handlers, with no flags or no thread, else stamps and wakes one.

Noting exits fast when current or the node lock is busy, else syncs position and needs under the lock and may wake. Completion advances ready callbacks to done, else reclassifies recents; new entry arms detection when the mask still awaits.

Local enqueue rechecks idleness, skips when masked or offline, and past a watermark starts or kicks a grace at most once per force counter. Core path skips offline, raises softirq in softirq mode, else wakes the thread.

Offloaded enqueue picks direct, bypass absorb, or flush then absorb or delegate from enablement, scheduler state, quota, laziness and bypass size or age. Wakeup picks immediate, deferred timer or lazy delay from poll mode, thread presence, empty transition and laziness.

structs.text: Descriptors bind per-flavor roles under labels srcud, tasks, tasks-rude, tasks-tracing: setup, bracketing, progress with difference rule, async, barrier, waits, thread accessor and conditional stats. Classic and rude drop stats under tiny builds.
Test object pairs a short payload with an embedded callback record. Control holds a task table, realized count, started and finished counters, monitor pointer and start time.

Observed node: range, current and furthest counters, quiescent mask, task links, boost count. Global: name, thread, stamps, seqs, counters, flags, wait queue, forced count. Per-processor: list, positions, wrap, quiescent flags, ticks, snapshots, limit, node link, mask, clock, work fields, read locklessly.
